title: Upcoming Cash Flow Shortfall
summary: You may be short on cash for your rent payment next week.
explanation: Your rent of $1,100 is due on Sept 1st. Based on your variable gig income trends, we project you will only earn $800 before then. Your current checking balance is $150.

suggested_actions.description: Transfer $150 from your Emergency Fund to Checking to cover the gap.
Pause discretionary spending (dining out) for the next 4 days.

decision_trace.detail: Projected freelance income fell below the rent threshold
